title: carriage returns inside raw strings are discarded
purpose: A raw string spanning a CRLF line break keeps only the LF.
spec_refs: Go spec: Raw string literals ("Carriage return characters ('\r') inside raw string literals are discarded")

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-030): as in Go, CR characters inside raw string literals are discarded, so the value is a, LF, b (length 3). Spec 4.2's 'every character is retained' must be amended.
